_purpose: Triage ONE finding from a multi-agent SEO/GEO audit: is it backed by evidence, is it an unmeasured claim, which area, which severity. One request per finding row. Truth fields for calibration: t_has_evidence, t_unmeasured_claim, t_category, t_severity.
_instance: Generic template. The audit chat copies this file into the project folder and fills context.site and context.owner_decisions_not_issues from owner-decisions.md before calibrating.

context.site: <filled per project: domains and what the business is>
context.task: Triage of one finding from an independent SEO/GEO audit of the site(s) in `context.site`. Judge only the finding text in `issue` and `evidence`.
owner_decisions_not_issues: <filled per project from owner-decisions.md, e.g. 'pages hidden by noindex + absent from sitemap are deliberately closed'>
conditional_cases_not_issues: the 3-click depth rule is not absolute
duplicates that are a SERP-domination positive
a lab number presented only as an estimate

severity_levels.critical: directly hurting rankings or preventing indexation: a page that should be indexed cannot be found or indexed (noindex or robots block or canonical to a dead URL on a page that must rank, 5xx on the page itself).
severity_levels.high: significant impact on SEO/GEO performance but does not block indexation: e.g. the owner's core entity is not glued (no canonical paragraph, related entities not linked), a page marked active in the page matrix returns 404, a whole language version is broken.
severity_levels.medium: best-practice violation with moderate impact: title/description/OG defects, hreflang cluster errors or missing cluster on a few pages, orphan SERVICE pages in the sitemap, broken internal links, structured-data validity/consistency problems (breadcrumb pointing to a redirect/noindex URL), a server error on a non-standard request.
severity_levels.low: minor optimization opportunity: missing image width/height, no cache validators on HTML, a 2-hop redirect chain, missing or oversized llms.txt, missing max-snippet directive, non-service content page with few inbound links, noise.
severity_levels.not_an_issue: an owner decision or conditional case listed above, OR a claim that has no URL/evidence, OR a conclusion drawn from one unrepeated answer or an unmeasured score.

has_evidence.instructions: Does the finding name at least one concrete URL or URL group AND give concrete verbatim evidence in `evidence` (an HTML/header/API quote, a count, a measured value, a command result)? Generic opinions ('the site is slow', 'titles should improve') without a URL and a measured/quoted fact do not count.

criteria.true: A concrete URL (or clear URL group with examples) and at least one quoted or measured fact are present.
criteria.false: No concrete URL, or only opinion/generic advice without a quoted or measured fact.

unmeasured_claim.instructions: Does the finding present an estimate, a score or a conclusion about AI-assistant visibility or citation as a measured fact when it is based on no measurement or on a single unrepeated answer (for example a made-up 'AI visibility score', or 'ChatGPT does not recommend the brand' from one query)?

criteria.true: A visibility score or an AI-recommendation conclusion is stated without a repeated measurement series or without the real answer texts.
criteria.false: The finding is about the site's own code, markup, content, headers, redirects or links, or it reports real measured data.

category.instructions: Which single area does the finding belong to?

criteria.indexation_crawl: robots, noindex, canonical, sitemap membership, crawl/indexing status in Google or Bing.
criteria.redirects_urls: redirects, redirect chains, trailing slash, host (www/apex), URL structure, 404s of URLs.
criteria.on_page_meta: title, meta description, robots meta directives, Open Graph, headings, on-page text.
criteria.structured_data: JSON-LD / schema.org (including breadcrumb data and dates inside JSON-LD).
criteria.internal_linking_architecture: internal links, orphan pages, navigation, site hierarchy.
criteria.content_quality: article/page content, cannibalization, keyword coverage, content gaps.
criteria.performance_server: page weight, images sizes/dimensions, caching headers, compression, server errors, response time.
criteria.international_hreflang: hreflang, language versions, localization of header/footer.
criteria.geo_ai_visibility: entity signals, llms.txt, AI-citability, AI crawler access, canonical self-description, knowledge-graph signals.

severity.instructions: Assign the severity of the finding using `context.severity_levels`. Choose not_an_issue when the finding is an owner decision or conditional case from the context, or has no evidence, or is an unmeasured claim.

criteria.critical: A page that should be indexed is blocked from or prevented in indexing, or directly hurts rankings (see context).
criteria.high: Significant impact on SEO/GEO performance but not blocking indexation (see context).
criteria.medium: Best-practice violation with moderate impact (see context).
criteria.not_an_issue: Owner decision, conditional case, unsupported claim, or noise (see context).
